name: qlb
description: Local quota visibility and account selection across AI coding providers

scripts.test: export QLB_TEST_MODE=1 QLB_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; node scripts/clean-registry-output.cjs dist-test/src && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.build:helper: bash -ceu 'out=native/keychain-helper/build/qlb-keychain-helper; src=native/keychain-helper/main.swift; identity="QLB Keychain Helper"; keychain="$HOME/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")" "$HOME/.qlb/helper-prev"; if [ -x "$out" ]; then cp "$out" "$HOME/.qlb/helper-prev/qlb-keychain-helper"; fi; if ! security find-identity -v -p codesigning "$keychain" 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq "$identity"; then tmp=$(mktemp -d); openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout "$tmp/key.pem" -out "$tmp/cert.pem" -subj "/CN=$identity/" -addext "extendedKeyUsage=codeSigning" -days 3650; openssl pkcs12 -export -out "$tmp/identity.p12" -inkey "$tmp/key.pem" -in "$tmp/cert.pem" -passout pass:; security import "$tmp/identity.p12" -k "$keychain" -P "" -T /usr/bin/codesign; rm -rf "$tmp"; fi; swiftc "$src" -o "$out"; codesign --force --sign "$identity" --timestamp=none "$out"'
